questions.prompt: Which topic is explicitly listed in the syllabus coverage for “Serving Files and Static Assets”?

questions.prompt: According to the worked example in “Serving Files and Static Assets”, which result should the learner verify?
options: The app publishes itself to production and passes all tests automatically.
HTTP 500 is returned for every valid request.
Input validation and authorization are disabled by design.
questions.explanation: The worked example explicitly documents this expected result. Reproduce it locally in the listed environment before treating it as tested behavior.

questions.prompt: Which integration practice best matches this topic? (Serving Files and Static Assets)
options: Bound uploads or requests, set timeouts, validate untrusted data and handle failures explicitly
Assume all external services always succeed
Retry every request forever without checking idempotency
Store uploaded files under raw client-supplied paths
questions.answer_key: Bound uploads or requests, set timeouts, validate untrusted data and handle failures explicitly
questions.explanation: External inputs and services can fail or be hostile; bound resources, validate requests and make retries safe.
